summary: Lower querySelector to the native DOM abstraction only for a statically supported selector subset.

semantics.return_value: first matching descendant Element in tree order, or null
semantics.invalid_selector: must raise SyntaxError DOMException; compiler may prevalidate static selectors

caveats: Do not implement selectors as ad-hoc string matching; CSS selector semantics and scoping must be preserved.
Unsupported pseudo-classes, namespaces, shadow-tree cases, or dynamic selectors use the runtime fallback rule.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § ParentNode querySelector/querySelectorAll
